why_it_breaks: When KVXR has no bar data (first position, no history), _meta_for sets price=0.0. In caps.py, _name_cap checks `meta.price < caps.penny_price_threshold`; with price=0.0 this condition is always true, so the function returns single_high_risk_pct (likely 25% or similar) instead of single_core_pct (15%). The risk check then applies the wrong cap and allows the 95% position to pass without violation.
